title: Hospitalization and beds
subtitle: Bed map by ward, admissions and transfers — one bed, one patient

beds.markReadyTitle: Is the bed ready for use?

create.title: Admit a patient
create.description: A free bed is required: a bed holds one patient, and a patient has one active admission.
create.notice: Billing of room days and discharge are handled with the hospital account.

hospReq.title: Hospitalization requests
hospReq.hint: The admissions desk sends the request; a doctor of the receiving ward approves or rejects it, with a reason. Once approved, choose the bed to admit the patient.
hospReq.dialogDescription: Give the receiving ward and the reason. Doctors of that ward are notified and must approve before any admission.
hospReq.serviceHint: Only a doctor of this ward can approve the request.
hospReq.noUnits: No ward: create a care unit in Administration first.
hospReq.approveBody: You confirm the indication to hospitalize {{patient}} in {{service}}. You become the attending physician.
hospReq.rejectBody: The request for {{patient}} will be rejected; the reason goes back to the admissions desk.
hospReq.cancelBody: The request for {{patient}} will no longer allow admitting the patient.
hospReq.noteHint: At least 5 characters. Kept in the audit log.

done.created: Request sent to the doctors of the ward.

admit.description: An admission always starts from a medical decision: the doctor's request during a consultation, or a request approved by a doctor of the ward.
admit.pickHint: Patients whose hospitalization was requested or approved by a doctor.
admit.groupApproved: Approved by a doctor of the ward
admit.none: No request to process. Send a hospitalization request first: a doctor of the ward must approve it.
admit.wardOnly: Only beds of {{service}} are offered. Attending physician: {{doctor}}.
admit.attendingAuto: The attending physician is the one who requested or approved the hospitalization.

detail.careBody: Bedside care follow-up (observations, care given) will be linked to the hospitalization API. No clinical data is shown in the demo.
detail.dischargeBody: The bed stays occupied until the actual discharge.
detail.description: Admission, successive stays and discharge request.
detail.cancelBody: For a data-entry error. The bed goes to cleaning; the reason is traced.
detail.dischargeNotice: Actual discharge (financial settlement, bed release) is handled with the hospital account.

emptyHint: Admit a patient from a free bed or from a consultation.

account.title: Hospital account
account.loadFailed: The account could not be loaded.
account.dischargeBody: Discharge frees the bed (cleaning) and closes the stay. All room days must be billed and the patient balance settled.
account.blockDays: {{count}} room day(s) are not billed yet.
account.blockBalance: Patient balance due: {{due}}. Collect it, authorize credit at the cashier, or enter a justified exception.
account.noException: You are not allowed to authorize a discharge with a balance due.
account.convention: Convention: the admission day counts, the discharge day does not, minimum one day. Organizations’ share does not block discharge.

visits.title: Visits and consumption
visits.empty: No consumption recorded for this stay.
visits.recordBody: Consumption is billed automatically when discharge is requested and at discharge. No price is entered here: it comes from the catalogue.
visits.emptyVisitHint: A round without consumption is valid.
visits.reverseBody: The original line is kept: a reasoned counter-entry is added. Not possible on an already billed line (cancel the invoice first).
visits.billBody: One invoice is created for the pending consumption; products leave stock (first expired, first out).
visits.noDiscountRight: You do not have permission to grant a discount.
visits.note: Billing is automatic when discharge is requested and at discharge. If it fails (e.g. not enough stock), discharge is not blocked: bill here as soon as possible. A reversal does not put the product back in stock.

clinical.complaintsHint: New symptoms or change compared with the previous symptoms.
clinical.noClinicalRight: Examination, diagnosis and plan are reserved for the doctor.
clinical.examinationHint: The doctor’s findings related to the complaints.
clinical.planHint: The plan is a decision: after saving, use “Request tests” or “Prescribe” on the visit. Discharge is requested in its own section.
clinical.afterSaveHint: After saving the visit, use the “Order tests” and “Prescribe” buttons on the visit, as in consultation.
clinical.noOrders: No tests or prescriptions for this visit.
